title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 Naming Work Item
summary: Add the RFC 9461 DNS SVCB service-name and default-port floor without building resolver discovery or provisioning behavior.
planned_changes:
- Add `DnsServiceTransport` and `DnsServiceBindingDefaults` under `Incursa.Quic.Dns`.
- Expose the mapped scheme `dns`, node name `_dns`, per-transport default ports, Port Prefix Naming, and DNS hostname/literal-IP authentication-name validation.
- Add focused unit tests for service-name construction, default ports, port-prefix boundaries, and authentication-name validation.
- Add requirement-home proof tying the code, tests, and SpecTrace artifacts together.
- Narrow the encrypted DNS discovery planning gap to show this RFC 9461 naming floor is now trace-owned.
verification_plan: Run a focused build for the DNS package, run RFC 9461 service-binding tests and requirement-home tests, validate core SpecTrace JSON artifacts, and confirm diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: SVCB record parser or resolver integration.
`alpn`, `dohpath`, `port`, and HTTPS SvcParam selection semantics beyond the scalar default-port/name helpers.
DoH URI-template expansion and request dispatch.
Changing QUIC transport packet, stream, TLS, or scheduler behavior.
completion_notes: The DNS adapter now has a trace-owned RFC 9461 naming/default-port floor that later discovery/provisioning work can consume.
